references.text: God describes how He has stretched out His hands toward a disobedient people, which mirrors the rejection faced by the five unprepared virgins.
This passage about knocking and seeking entry shares thematic similarities with the virgins who ask to be let in.
The Lord says there will come a time when the door is shut, and those outside will stand knocking and begging to be let in, like the virgins who arrived too late.
